headline: Euro Declines on French Fiscal Concerns While Yen Rallies on Tech Pullback
summary: The euro dropped amid concerns over French government debt, while the Japanese yen advanced for the week following a rout in artificial intelligence shares. The US Dollar Index gained to 101.82.
why: Foreign exchange markets react sharply to sovereign debt risks in core euro area economies and broader global equity shifts, affecting global trade balances and corporate currency hedging.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: Equity market volatility in the tech sector spurs demand for traditional safe-haven assets including the yen.

why_moved: The euro fell due to investor anxiety regarding French sovereign debt sustainability, while equity declines in the AI tech segment drove safe-haven capital into the Japanese yen.
